Hi Alicia / Priya —

We'd like to get the ACE registration in place and loop in AWS PDM/PSM so we can align on co-sell motions and shared activities (marketplace listing, co-marketing assets, and seller enablement). Attached is a short opportunity summary and our draft ACE registration form.

Proposed immediate asks: 
- Alicia / Priya: can you confirm the ACE registration next steps and who will own the PDM/PSM intro?
- AWS: please confirm any required artifacts for HIPAA evidence for marketplace listing.
- Novare (Bryan): would you be open to a joint PDM/PDM intro + 30-min discovery next week (we can host)?

Jonas and Vanessa — I’ve copied you for the technical/psm alignment and marketplace checklist. Vanessa, can you draft a short MAP (mutual action plan) after the AWS intro?

Thanks,

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the summary and the materials. Happy to get this moving. I’ll kick off ACE registration on our side and I’ve looped in Priya (PSM for the healthcare vertical) to join the intro.

Quick notes from our side:
- We’ll need the ACE registration form filled out (looks like you included a draft — I’ll upload after you confirm)
- For HIPAA-sensitive customers we typically collect the following: SOC2 report, encryption and KMS details, basic data flow diagram, and an indicative SLA. If you can share SOC2 and a short data flow sketch we can expedite the security review.
- PDM/PSM intro: Priya will be the point PSM; I’ll coordinate the PDM side. We can do a 30-min alignment early next week (Mon/Tue).

Priya — can you introduce yourself and share your calendar availability?
